scope: Full local root regression gate using the same selected file globs and concurrency as phone CI. Each file runs directly in its own Node process to expose its internal counters, matching the preceding verified local gate method.
countingRule: Formal per-file counters are summed. The standalone auth program is reported separately; its checks are not added to formal counts or the single wrapper case used by CI.
executionContext: Approved execution for subprocess and loopback fixture operations; source and assertions unchanged from the initial restricted attempt.
limit: This local Node regression run does not verify native UIKit rendering, an Android emulator process, physical device speed, Photos, or signed release processing.
